notes.subject: jasare
notes.rationale: חיל is force/valor/might in the broad sense; 'jasare' (bravery) narrows it to the martial nuance.

notes.subject: refrain
notes.rationale: verse 60:14 repeats 60:12 nearly verbatim — the refrain closes the psalm's two halves; the repetition itself is the rhetoric.

notes.subject: duguma
notes.rationale: 'down' added to 'ju' (tread) to render the trampling picture natural in Bamanankan.

translation: Elohim fɛ, an bɛ jasare kɛ; ani ale de bɛna an ka kɛlɛbagaw ju duguma.
